title: Recorded compactification support tower and finite evaluations
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its completed integral coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and separated finite-type $k$-schemes with $\ell$ invertible in $k$. For a compactification $c=(j,p)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], use the specified integral compact-support action [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Define supportTower and supportEvaluation to be exactly the strict tower and its evaluation coordinates already selected in that action. The evaluation at index $n\ge0$ is the restricted finite composite $Rp_*j_!(K\otimes^L A_{n+1})$ with its prescribed quotient transitions. These are aliases of the recorded selection, not a fresh choice of towers or maps.
